name: menuyukti
description: Local restaurant POS analytics for Codex: workspaces, menu engineering, heatmaps, and weak-items review via Menuyukti MCP on your machine.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze local POS Excel sales privately with Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to a local Menuyukti Skybridge MCP server on your computer. Bundle includes coaching and visualisation skills for venue slot strength, menu heatmaps, and weak items. Requires pnpm mcp (Node 24+) at http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp and MENUYUKTI_DATA_DIR with your workspaces. Desktop only (localhost MCP).
defaultPrompt: Using Menuyukti, check setup status and summarize demo-cafe-july-2026.
